text:
pagerbot: INCIDENT PAGE - suspicious outbound auth activity from auth-broker (us-west-2). rate ~8 req/s -> sustained for 6m. potential token reuse pattern. severity: P1. paging oncall maria. 

maria (oncall): ack. joining. any immediate customer impact?

samir (eng-sre): looking at edge logs now. I see repeated 401s followed by a handful of 200s with odd user-agent string 'curl/7.85.0-rotor'. suspect automated client replay. pulling request IDs.

leah (security): thanks. if tokens are being reused we should assume creds exposure until proven otherwise. can we rotate service token for auth-broker and list affected API keys? also enable short TTL on edge for now.

maria (oncall): samir - share top 3 request IDs and sample headers. i'll spin up temporary rule to block that UA and rate-limit source IP range.

samir (eng-sre): sample log snippet:

```
[2026-09-07T22:01:12Z] auth-broker us-west-2 req_id=ac3f9e UA=curl/7.85.0-rotor src=34.82.11.99 path=/v1/token grant_type=client_credentials status=200 token_id=tok-0a1b2c
[2026-09-07T22:01:13Z] auth-broker us-west-2 req_id=ac3f9f UA=curl/7.85.0-rotor src=34.82.11.99 path=/v1/introspect status=200
[2026-09-07T22:02:54Z] edge us-west-2 req_id=ac4a00 UA=curl/7.85.0-rotor src=34.82.11.99 path=/v1/generate status=401
```

samir (eng-sre): IP is in a cloud provider range. looks like replay from compromised CI runner or scraped token set.

jordan (support): any customers hit? I see a small uptick in 401s for two orgs (org-417 and org-52) but no escalations yet. I'll open an internal ticket and prep a short customer note if we confirm leakage.

leah (security): immediate actions: 1) rotate auth-broker service token(s) used by internal infra; 2) rotate any tokens observed in logs (if present); 3) block offending IPs and UA at edge; 4) search logstore for token fragments and mark scope. Maria/Samir can you take 1-3 now? Jordan to track customer comms.

maria (oncall): on it. creating rotation job for auth-broker service account via KMS key-swap. taking auth-broker out of rotation briefly to ensure new tokens cut over. will push allowlist rules after we confirm.

samir (eng-sre): firewall rule applied to block 34.82.11.0/24, UA blacklist added. I'll also trigger a quick KV cache flush on auth-broker to invalidate any long-lived sessions.

pagerbot: ACTIONS LOGGED -> incident/SEC-1427 created. runbooks: auth-leak-playbook v2.1 referenced.

maria (oncall): auth-broker service token rotated (KMS key id: redwood-kms-3). new token rolled to factories. auth-broker back on. confirm health: 200s resume for internal probes.

samir (eng-sre): edge probes show legitimate traffic normalizing. still seeing low volume of 401s from other IPs, running broader search for UA 'rotor'.

leah (security): good. Jordan, please escalate to customer success for org-417 and org-52 with a brief: 'We observed suspicious auth traffic toward our service; we rotated internal tokens and blocked sources. No evidence of customer key compromise at this time. We'll follow up if scope changes.' Keep copy to legal if any PII appears.

jordan (support): noted. drafting notice and will cc legal. also opening post-incident ticket for follow-up.

samir (eng-sre): found ~9 token-like fragments in staging logs (not production). likely leaked CI env var. tagging repo owners and triggering revocation for staging tokens.

leah (security): staging leaks still matter. rotate staging secrets and audit CI runners and third-party actions. add MFA enforcement for deploy keys.

maria (oncall): handing off to jen for overnight monitoring. jen, checklist: confirm edge UA block holds, monitor 401/200 rate, follow up on search results for token fragments, and coordinate with security on any new findings.

jen (oncall-2): taking over. ping me if anything spikes or if legal wants to draft customer comms.

pagerbot: INCIDENT UPDATE -> mitigations applied, status: stabilizing. severity downgraded to P2 for monitoring.

leah (security): next steps (post-incident): long-term rotation for all staging tokens, CI secret scan rollout, incident review w/ SRE + Security, and retro on runbook gaps. Assigning owners now in SEC-1427.

jordan (support): customer notes queued, will hold send pending security sign-off.

maria (oncall): closing live bridge for now. reopen if any new indicators. great quick work everyone :thumbsup:
